t: The Brackenheath iSpot Swivel is a 16W outdoor LED twin floodlight designed to deliver 2100 lumens of bright cool white light. Ideal for driveways, pathways and commercial security lighting, this durable IP65-rated unit features a robust polycarbonate body and diffuser. A fast-fix backplate ensures quick installation on walls or eaves, while the adjustable heads provides 180° swivel and 70° tilt for precise positioning. Can be controlled by the PIR version of this product, up to 8 fittings (max. 150W LED load), when linked in series.
b: Series Control Compatibility for Linking up to 8 Fittings
Fast-Fix Backplate for Quick & Simple Installation
Mounting Versatility for Wall or Eaves Installation
